name: Alcântara Space Center
manufacturer: Brazilian Air Force (DCTA / Alcântara Launch Center)
best_known_for: Brazil's equatorial launch centre: VLS-1 failures, the 2003 pad explosion, sounding rockets
credit: Facts from the Wikipedia articles on the Alcântara Space Center and VLS-1, including its launch list. The centre is a launch facility of the Brazilian Space Agency (AEB) and is operated by the Brazilian Air Force; it was named Alcântara Launch Center until 2021. Coordinates are the VLS pad on English Wikipedia.
